english:
Kills through any means during a Super grant Super Energy after the Super ends, up to 33% after 6 kills.

Kills with Super damage while outside a Super grant 5.5% Super Energy each, up to 33%.

Casting a Super resets the refund cap. Removing Supercyclical and reacquiring the 4-piece bonus by changing gear also resets the cap.

source.text:
4 Piece | Supercyclical

Upon scoring kills while in a Super Ability:
Up to 33% Super Ability Energy after 6 kills once it ends.

Upon scoring kills with Super Damage while NOT in a Super Ability:
5.5% Super Energy per Kill, up to 33% Super Ability Energy.

Super Ability Refund Cap is reset on Super Ability Cast or upon swaping off of Supercyclical and then reacquiring the 4 Piece Perk by changing gear.
